title: Geophysics II
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the continuous assessment component of your course."
The TMA is the continuous assessment component of your course.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the commonest causes of accidents."
Detonators are the commonest causes of accidents.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the time at which the back- extrapolated refracted arrival line cuts the time axis."
The intercept time ti is defined as the time at which the back- extrapolated refracted arrival line cuts the time axis.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the only common rock having a high velocity but a low density."
Salt is the only common rock having a high velocity but a low density.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the earliest known instrument for indicating the arrival of seismic tremor from a distant source is reputed to have been invented by a Chinese astronomer called Chang Heng in 13AD."
The seismograph is the earliest known instrument for indicating the arrival of seismic tremor from a distant source is reputed to have been invented by a Chinese astronomer called Chang Heng in 13AD.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the most vulnerable parts of a seismic system and are most at risk where they join."
Cables and plugs are the most vulnerable parts of a seismic system and are most at risk where they join.
fib: ______ is the most reliable way of distinguishing shallow reflections from refractions.
Curvature is the most reliable way of distinguishing shallow reflections from refractions.
______ are known as geophones, marine detectors as hydrophones.
Land seismic detectors are known as geophones, marine detectors as hydrophones.
______ are the most effective and the most expensive of all the geophysical techniques used to investigate layered media.
Seismic methods are the most effective and the most expensive of all the geophysical techniques used to investigate layered media.
______ are used less than they deserve.
Centre shots are used less than they deserve.
______ is a small charge of dynamite.
The traditional seismic source is a small charge of dynamite.
______ is used very widely and most instruments now provide graphic displays, optional hard copy and digital recording.
Enhancement is used very widely and most instruments now provide graphic displays, optional hard copy and digital recording.
